ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ADDENDUM

This Artificial Intelligence Addendum (this "Addendum") is entered into as of February 17, 2026 by and between Halloway Municipal Utilities District ("Customer") and Sablefield Software, Inc. ("Vendor"), and is incorporated into and forms part of the Master Services Agreement between Customer and Vendor dated August 4, 2023 (the "Agreement"). Capitalized terms used but not defined in this Addendum have the meanings given to them in the Agreement. Except as expressly modified by this Addendum, the Agreement remains in full force and effect. In the event of a conflict between this Addendum and the Agreement with respect to the subject matter of this Addendum, this Addendum controls.

1. Scope. This Addendum applies whenever Vendor uses, or makes available to Customer, any AI System in connection with the Services.

2. Definitions.

2.1 "AI System" means a machine-based system that, for a given set of objectives, generates outputs such as predictions, recommendations, content, or decisions, including any system built on a foundation or large language model.

2.2 "Customer Data" has the meaning given in the Agreement, and includes any prompt, instruction, document, or other input that Customer or its Authorized Users submit to an AI System.

2.3 "Output" means any content generated by an AI System in response to Customer Data.

2.4 "High-Risk Use" means any use of an AI System to make or materially inform a decision that produces a legal or similarly significant effect on an individual, including decisions about employment, credit, housing, insurance, education, or access to essential utility service.

3. Training Restriction. Vendor shall not use, and shall not permit any subprocessor or model provider to use, Customer Data or Output to train, fine-tune, or otherwise improve any AI System or model that is made available to any party other than Customer. Vendor shall contractually bind each model provider to this restriction and shall, on Customer's written request, identify each model provider and the applicable contractual term.

4. Human Oversight. Vendor shall not deploy any AI System in a High-Risk Use without Customer's prior written approval. Where Customer approves a High-Risk Use, Vendor shall provide a documented mechanism by which a qualified human reviewer can review, override, and reverse the AI System's output before it takes effect, and shall log each such review.

5. Disclosure and Transparency. Vendor shall notify Customer in writing at least thirty (30) days before introducing any new AI System into the Services, or before materially changing the model, provider, or training data underlying an existing AI System. Each notice shall identify the model and provider, describe the intended use, and state whether the AI System interacts directly with individuals.

6. Accuracy and Evaluation. Vendor shall evaluate each AI System for accuracy, robustness, and disparate impact before deployment and at least annually thereafter, using a documented methodology, and shall make the results of each evaluation available to Customer within ten (10) business days of Customer's request.

7. Intellectual Property in Output. As between the parties, Customer owns all right, title, and interest in and to Customer Data and, to the extent permitted by applicable law, Output generated from Customer Data. Vendor assigns to Customer any right it may acquire in such Output. Vendor makes no representation that Output is protectable by copyright or that it is free of similarity to third-party materials, and Customer acknowledges that under current United States law material generated without sufficient human authorship may not be eligible for copyright registration.

8. Third-Party Claims. Vendor shall defend Customer against any third-party claim that an AI System or Output infringes or misappropriates that third party's intellectual property rights, and shall indemnify Customer against damages and costs finally awarded, provided that Customer promptly notifies Vendor of the claim, gives Vendor sole control of the defense and settlement, and provides reasonable cooperation at Vendor's expense. Vendor shall not settle any claim in a manner that imposes a non-monetary obligation on Customer without Customer's prior written consent, which shall not be unreasonably withheld.

9. Prohibited Uses. Vendor shall not use any AI System to generate biometric identifiers from Customer Data, to infer emotional state, or to score or rank individuals for any purpose, in each case without Customer's prior written approval.

10. Records and Audit. Vendor shall maintain records of each AI System used in the Services, the model and provider, the evaluation results, and the human-oversight logs required by Section 4, for the longer of three (3) years or the retention period stated in the Agreement, and shall make them available for Customer's audit under the audit provisions of the Agreement.

11. Suspension. Customer may suspend Vendor's use of any AI System in the Services on written notice if Customer reasonably determines that the AI System presents a material risk of unlawful discrimination, a material inaccuracy affecting utility service decisions, or a breach of this Addendum. Suspension under this Section is not a breach by Customer and does not relieve Vendor of its obligations under the Agreement.

12. Order of Precedence. This Addendum supplements and does not limit the data protection, confidentiality, security, and indemnification provisions of the Agreement, each of which continues to apply to Customer Data and Output.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have executed this Addendum as of the date first written above.

HALLOWAY MUNICIPAL UTILITIES DISTRICT
